## S05 UI, automation and future contracts

Seven pages now distinguish the implemented optional save-context carrier and current legacy automation from unimplemented general UI-action, audit/storm and plugin contracts. [S05-EVIDENCE.md](S05-EVIDENCE.md) maps every page to raw authority, real producer/consumer chains and negative searches; S05-SOURCE-EVIDENCE.json records current source hashes. Durable automation runId/kind, T1/T2 history and T3 exclusion are preserved; exact future schemas/executors/output/lifecycle choices are not invented. S05 uses current owner-directed metadata with real edit times; parent completion stamping and earlier-page migration remain separate. No product tests/runtime were run.

## S05 bounded updates

- DEP-03: Capture 030 PLUG-D012 is explicitly pending; only individually owner-adopted decisions are binding. Current host-sealed four publishers and three subscribed fact types do not admit arbitrary plugins. Plugin owner must reconcile eventual registration/capability grammar with PW-D05 without raw bus access, self-grants or System app tables. No external capture edits.
- DEP-04: Capture 032 §2/§6 broad LED/ULV/hash and never-delay language omits accepted save preimage/hash and bounded agent fingerprint/checkpoint/ledger overlays. Its §2/§3 evidence-layer claim that lifecycle shape is settled goes beyond durable common automation.runId/kind: per-kind generation/lifecycle/output ABI remains open. Its design-phase/not-SPEC status cannot approve a producer, output schema or live-app table. Exact capture correction belongs to plugin owner before implementation.
- DEP-01/02: current operational attachments use SendToChatButton → chat-action → useLegacyChatHost → chatSlice prompt, with workspace/session pending attachment ownership. This is not a general ui.action envelope; old useChatArea pointers are stale. Future Wiki/File adapter work must coordinate current Chat group/session/surface/placement owners and connected File selectors. No protected Chat/shared-view page was edited.
- S06: preserve narrow current save reader (registered initiating panel, matching File connected owner), server shape/echo sanitation without live tab existence validation, historical context/no writeback, and absent production query display. T1/T2 versus T3 direction is not universal current coverage. Retain automation common fields while keeping output, causal handoff and general lifecycle details open.
- DEP-06/07 normalization remains S06 as root instructed: corrected wiki.js guidance and current source-only metadata supersede old notes; no generator is run. S05-D01 affects only current-page metadata and cumulative validator expectations.
